signature.name: VTask.take
signature.type: (p : DyckWord) -> (i : ℕ) -> (hi : List.count DyckStep.U (List.take i ↑p) = List.count DyckStep.D (List.take i ↑p)) -> DyckWord

domain.constraint: List.count DyckStep.U (List.take i ↑p) = List.count DyckStep.D (List.take i ↑p)

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The function is total on its domain; all inputs satisfying the explicit balance hypothesis `hi` produce a well-formed DyckWord with no junk values or special-case overrides.

facts.statement: ∀ (p : DyckWord) (i : ℕ) (hi : List.count DyckStep.U (List.take i ↑p) = List.count DyckStep.D (List.take i ↑p)), (VTask.take p i hi).toList.length = min i p.toList.length
